from PIL import Image
import numpy as np, glob
from pathlib import Path
OUT=Path('/var/tmp/go-avatar-eye-mask-shadow-v1'); assert (OUT/'eye_identity_mask.png').exists()
expr=sorted(glob.glob('ausdruck_erweitert/*/*/frontal/stufe_*.png')); assert len(expr)==308
W,H=1536,1024; x0=round(W*.31); y0=round(H*.12); pw=round(W*.27)
raw=Image.open('augen_blink/blink_000.png').convert('RGBA'); ph=round(pw*raw.height/raw.width)
mask=np.asarray(Image.open(OUT/'eye_identity_mask.png').resize((pw,ph),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)).astype(np.float32)/255.0
plate=np.asarray(Image.open(OUT/'eye_identity_open.png').convert('RGBA').resize((pw,ph),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)).astype(np.float32)
# Effective alpha includes both the derived eye mask and photographed patch alpha.
alpha=(plate[:,:,3]/255.0)*mask
plate_rgb=plate[:,:,:3]
# Stack only mapped eye ROI: ~82k pixels x 308 x 3 fits comfortably.
stack=[]
for p in expr:
 im=np.asarray(Image.open(p).convert('RGBA'),dtype=np.float32)
 stack.append(im[y0:y0+ph,x0:x0+pw,:3])
X=np.stack(stack,axis=0)
Y=X*(1.0-alpha[None,:,:,None])+plate_rgb[None,:,:,:]*alpha[None,:,:,None]
def summarize(name,sel):
 n=int(sel.sum()); assert n
 sb=X[:,:, :, :].std(axis=0).mean(axis=2)[sel]
 sa=Y.std(axis=0).mean(axis=2)[sel]
 mb=float(sb.mean()); ma=float(sa.mean()); ratio=(ma/mb if mb else 0.0)
 print(name,'PIXELS',n,'STD_BEFORE',round(mb,4),'STD_AFTER',round(ma,4),'RATIO',round(ratio,6),'REDUCTION_PCT',round((1-ratio)*100,3))
 print(name+'_P50_P90_BEFORE',round(float(np.quantile(sb,.5)),4),round(float(np.quantile(sb,.9)),4),'AFTER',round(float(np.quantile(sa,.5)),4),round(float(np.quantile(sa,.9)),4))
summarize('CORE_A240',alpha>=240/255)
summarize('MID_A128',alpha>=128/255)
summarize('FEATHER_A8_239',(alpha>=8/255)&(alpha<240/255))
# Exact canonical convergence: count pixels whose post-composite range across all 308 expressions is <=1 RGB level per channel.
rng_before=(X.max(axis=0)-X.min(axis=0)).max(axis=2); rng_after=(Y.max(axis=0)-Y.min(axis=0)).max(axis=2)
for label,sel in [('CORE_A240',alpha>=240/255),('MID_A128',alpha>=128/255),('NZ',alpha>0)]:
 print('RANGE',label,'LE1_BEFORE',round(float((rng_before[sel]<=1).mean()),6),'LE1_AFTER',round(float((rng_after[sel]<=1).mean()),6),'MED_BEFORE',round(float(np.median(rng_before[sel])),3),'MED_AFTER',round(float(np.median(rng_after[sel])),3))
# Outside eye mask output is mathematically equal to input; report size and assert with one expression numeric composite.
outside=alpha==0; print('ROI_OUTSIDE_MASK_PIXELS',int(outside.sum()),'ROI_TOTAL',alpha.size,'OUTSIDE_FRAC',round(float(outside.mean()),6))
assert np.max(np.abs(Y[0][outside]-X[0][outside]))==0
print('OUTSIDE_MASK_MAX_DELTA=0')
print('SCOPE=READ_ONLY_308_EXPRESSION_IDENTITY_VARIANCE')
PY
